subject: [PATCH v4 08/11] mm, swap: only charge physical swap entries

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch modifies the way memory swap is charged to a cgroup's memcg->swap counter. Instead of charging when a vswap entry is allocated, it charges only when the entry acquires physical backing. This change ensures that zswap-backed and zero-filled pages are not counted towards the cgroup's swap usage. The patch also refactors the swap memcg operations into separate helpers for getting, recording, charging, uncharging, and putting the owner, which is a prerequisite for this change. As a result, memory.swap.current will only count on-disk swap usage, allowing cgroups to reclaim their anon memory even with memory.swap.max set to 0 if zswap is enabled.
